correctness.rationale: Conditional Gaussianity reduces every fourth cumulant to 3 times the conditional-variance fluctuation. A centered renewal-reward variance theorem applies because exponential periods have all moments and integrated-OU segment variance grows linearly in duration. Exact integration yields the two rational functions, verified algebraically and against an independent Laplace-generator moment recursion for three rational rates. Derivatives factor into strictly positive denominators times two degree-six polynomials with precisely one sign change each; endpoint signs and limits give existence, uniqueness and global maximality. The claimed boundaries are γ,D,λ>0, t→∞; no finite enumeration is treated as a universal proof.

value.rationale: The reset-frequency optimum for absolute fourth-order non-Gaussian fluctuations is not the optimum for the natural dimensionless standardized excess kurtosis. The exact two-root classification across the entire continuous positive parameter domain is a physically motivated non-Gaussian transport criterion rather than an arbitrary selected numerical invariant. It strengthens prior second-moment and general generating-function work at a meaningful observable and specifies which reset rate is appropriate for two distinct measurements without claiming a general new resetting formalism.
